# DSH Java Mobile (dsh-java-mobile) — Multi-platform shell

> Shell project for DSH Java: Android, iOS, HarmonyOS and WeChat mini-program share the **same**
> React H5 artifact produced by dsh-java-desktop. No second UI stack.

Platforms:
- Android  Tauri 2 Mobile (Rust + Kotlin plugins)  -> APK/AAB with `h5-dist`
- iOS      Tauri 2 Mobile (Rust + Swift plugins)   -> IPA with `h5-dist`
- HarmonyOS ArkTS/ArkUI + ArkWeb                   -> HAP with `rawfile/h5`
- Mini app Taro 4 + React (reuses protocol SDK)    -> `miniapp/dist`

Key capabilities:
- One front-end build, distributed to all hosts with hash verification
- Device pairing (short code), mobile access toggle, credential storage
- Platform capability contract (transport, credential, file, notify, git, ...)
- Release gates: artifact paths, size, security, offline, consistency

Version: 0.1.0
Repository: https://github.com/linlannet/dsh-java-mobile
Related: dsh-java-desktop (UI source of truth), dsh-java, dsh-java-release

Commands:
- `node scripts/desktop_regression.mjs ../dsh-java-desktop .`   full regression
- `node scripts/distribute_h5.mjs ../dsh-java-desktop/dist`    distribute artifact
- `node scripts/check_release_consistency.mjs ..`             cross-repo hash check
- `npm run android:build` / `npm run ios:build`
- `cd miniapp && npm install && npm run build:weapp`

Layout:
- src-tauri/  shared Tauri shell
- harmony/    HarmonyOS ArkTS shell (ArkWeb + JSBridge)
- miniapp/    Taro mini-program shell
- scripts/    build, gate and regression scripts
- docs/specs/mobile_app_evolution/  spec, tasks, acceptance

Docs:
- README.md / README.en.md
- docs/specs/mobile_app_evolution/
- AGENTS.md
